9 اِرْتَهَوْا They became commingled, confounded, or confused. (K.) ＝
-A2- Also, (K,) or ارتهوا رَهِيَّةً, (TA,) They made رَهِيَّة; i. e. they took ears of corn, and rubbed them with their hands, then bruised, or pounded, them, and poured milk thereon, and then cooked this mixture. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
